🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON, as supplied; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, with small caps outperforming large caps and broad sector participation supporting the regime. Confirmation is tempered by rising fear: VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND, while the stocks/bonds ratio (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -7.04%) is ↓ falling and BELOW TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress is easing near-term: HYG/LQD (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.68%) ↑ rising and in RECOVERY, though the monthly decline remains a caution. Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND; stocks versus bonds (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -7.04%) ↓ falling and BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Mixed: the dollar-strength indicator (1W: -0.03% | 1M: +0.38%) → flat and in CORRECTION, while the yield-curve indicator (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +4.79%) → flat and in CORRECTION. Duration preference (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +2.51%) → flat and in CORRECTION.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Rotation from Tech toward cyclicals, alongside strong defensive-sector performance: XLK (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND, while consumer-discretionary and financial-sector breadth are positive. Energy strength is confirmed by XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND; style: Value over Growth, with defensive leadership also evident in XLP (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND.

5. US vs Global?
US large caps remain weak: SPY (1W: -0.56% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND, while small caps are firmer: IWM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +0.11%) ABOVE TREND. Europe is in RECOVERY: FEZ (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -1.59%); China is in RECOVERY: FXI (1W: +2.38% | 1M: -2.48%); emerging markets remain weak: EEM (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -8.64%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is weak: ARKK (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -9.59%) BELOW TREND. Small caps hold up better: IWM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +0.11%) ABOVE TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Oil leads: BNO (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND. Copper is soft: CPER (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -1.32%) BELOW TREND; gold and silver are also weak: GLD (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -7.05%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains strong: XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND. Natural gas is under pressure: UNG (1W: -5.22% | 1M: -10.63%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: broad sector breadth at 10/11 and energy strength in XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: risk assets and hedges disagree—SPY (1W: -0.56% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND while TLT (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +5.31%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor value/cyclical exposure selectively, with XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND showing strength; defensive participation remains notable in XLV (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to weak growth and speculative leadership, including XLK (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND; bonds retain support in TLT (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +5.31%) ABOVE TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If broad breadth holds, favor energy exposure through XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If tech weakness persists, monitor XLK (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.25%) BELOW TREND for further relative underperformance.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If oil momentum persists, monitor BNO (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If precious-metals weakness continues, watch GLD (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -7.05%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7426 (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.68%), currently ↑ rising and in RECOVERY; stocks/bonds at 9.2341 (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -7.04%), ↓ falling and BELOW TREND. Tech/financials relative strength is 3.1766 (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -14.96%), ↓ falling and BELOW TREND; copper/gold is 0.1096 (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +5.41%), ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, as supplied; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, though risk confirmation is mixed. Energy strength in XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND and small-cap resilience in IWM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +0.11%) ABOVE TREND contrast with weak growth leadership. Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND and bond outperformance in TLT (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +5.31%) ABOVE TREND.
